summary: Build practical ISO 37301 CMS implementation skills and prepare for the PECB Lead Implementer exam in this five-day course.
audienceIntro: ISO 37301 Lead Implementer training suits people who shape, coordinate, advise on, or evaluate a compliance management system and its implementation.
modules: Monitor and Improve the ISO 37301 CMS
prerequisites: To participate, you need basic knowledge of ISO management system standards, a general understanding of ISO 37301 or ISO 19600, and knowledge of management system implementation principles.
